title: 🏦 savings sync
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. File the month's investment records and refresh the holdings section.
2. Run the monthly savings routine: update balances, reconcile against statements, recompute metrics.

Private instruction (not public): https://github.com/kapetim/private/blob/main/src/finance/savings.md

## ✅ Done when

- Month's records filed and reconciled
- Holdings reflect current positions
- Savings snapshot refreshed
